what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Botswana in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 789 asylum seekers from Botswana, and Ireland hosted 64.0% of them.
After Ireland, the largest hosts are the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Botswana, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 1389, at the end of 2023, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
